gaps.sentence: ___ life in the countryside is much quieter.
gaps.explanation: 'Life' in a general sense takes no article: Life is hard sometimes.

gaps.sentence: ___ problem is that people don't recycle enough.
gaps.explanation: The problem (the one we are discussing); people in general takes no article.

gaps.sentence: They organized ___ charity concert for flood victims.
gaps.explanation: 'A charity concert' — one of many possible concerts, first mention.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ only person to solve the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: 'The only person' — 'only' makes the noun unique, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ last person to leave the building.
gaps.explanation: Ordinals take 'the': the last person, the first time.

gaps.sentence: ___ spaceship travelled for six months before reaching Mars.
gaps.explanation: The spaceship — the one in the story; Mars takes no article.
'Inflation' as a general economic concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: He received ___ OBE in the New Year's Honours list.
gaps.explanation: 'OBE' is pronounced /əʊ biː iː/, starting with a vowel sound, so 'an' is used.
